einzeiler: Musician Duane Betts on growing up with Dickie Betts and his path in Southern rock.
kurzfassung: Musician Duane Betts discusses growing up as the son of Allman Brothers Band legend Dickie Betts. He shares memories of touring as a teenager, his early days as a guitar tech, and his current projects including the Allman Betts Family Revival. Betts also reflects on overcoming addiction and the turning points of his career.
stichpunkte: Growing up as the son of Allman Brothers guitarist Dickie Betts in Sarasota
Moving to California at age twelve before returning to Florida to be homeschooled on tour
Starting as a drummer before switching to guitar at age thirteen
Working as an assistant guitar tech for the Allman Brothers under Joe Dan Petty
Touring with Kid Rock in 2004 and an unexpected encounter with Michael Jordan
Overcoming addiction and getting sober as a major turning point in his life and career
Keeping his family's musical legacy alive through the Allman Betts Family Revival with Devin Allman

clips.hook: Giving legendary songs everything he has
clips.text: When performing classic tracks from his family's catalog, the artist feels immense pressure to deliver an exceptional performance and do the material justice.

clips.hook: A teenage deal to go on tour
clips.text: An unexpected phone call from his father brought a compromise: moving back to Florida meant being homeschooled while traveling on tour with the band.

clips.hook: Building a custom drum kit from warehouse spare parts
clips.text: Instead of taking up the ukulele, the young future musician wanted to play drums, prompting his father to assemble a makeshift kit using equipment from a rehearsal space.

clips.hook: An unexpected Monday night hangout with NBA legends
clips.text: What sounded like a massive party at a suburban Detroit home turned out to be a quiet evening watching football with Michael Jordan and other sports icons.

clips.hook: Sobriety as the ultimate career turning point
clips.text: Leaving behind a difficult phase of addiction and achieving sobriety opened up new professional doors and shifted his perspective on life.

beschreibung: Duane Betts is on Celebrity Jobber with Jeff Zito this week. What type of work would Duane be doing if he wasn't a guitarist and singer-songwriter who leads Duane Betts & Palmetto Motel and is a co-founding member of The Allman Betts Band? Many celebrities will tell you that if not for that one lucky break or meeting, they would have been washing dishes like The Rock or skinning deer at a butcher shop like Ashton Kutcher. In other words, they may have been just a jobber. Thanks for listening. Please rate, review, and subscribe to the Celebrity Jobber with Jeff Zito wherever you get your podcasts.
